feeds.title: Age UK
feeds.description: Age UK is the country's largest charity dedicated to helping everyone make the most of later life. We believe that living longer should be celebrated and everything we do is designed to change the way we age for the better and enable everyone to be part of the solution. Together, we can create a world where everyone can love later life.

feeds.title: Caring UK
feeds.description: Caring UK magazine goes to more than 13,000 care homes nationwide. By delivering the latest news and ideas through our magazines we have helped to drive the industry forward by promoting innovation, technology, and best practice to our carefully selected and sought-after database.

feeds.title: Access Care Blog
feeds.description: We provide peace of mind by arranging for the finest carers to live with your loved ones in their own home. We are here to help you place Live-in Care with minimum fuss and maximum efficiency. Read live-in care articles about elderly care options, condition awareness, elderly health & wellbeing tips, and advice on our blog!

feeds.title: River Garden Home Care Blog
feeds.description: Drawing upon over 40 years of care experience, River Garden Care is a specialist domiciliary care provider, supporting older people in the comfort of their own homes. Their mission is to deliver the highest quality of home care and support to older people in the same way as we would expect our own family members to be cared for.

feeds.title: MyLife Home Care Blog
feeds.description: MyLife is leading the way in providing the very best standard in UK private home care services, helping to enhance people's lives, and enabling them to continue living at home. We offer the widest range of services available from one company; from a weekly one-hour companionship visit to a specialist, nurse-led care for more complex health needs.

feeds.title: PRN Nursing & Homecare Services Blog
feeds.description: PRN provides a bespoke care service to adults of all ages living at home or in the local community. We provide a wide variety of support ranging from domestic help to complex care needs, whether short or long-term. Read the latest news from PRN Nursing & Homecare Services, which provides bespoke care services to adults, the elderly, or the infirm.

feeds.title: Walfinch Home Care
feeds.description: Walfinch provides bespoke, high-quality care at home to individuals and families across the UK. We aim not just to help you maintain your lifestyle but to enhance your independence and help you live comfortably in your own home. On our news & events page, you can find out our latest events and everything you need to know about home care, dementia care, and the whole range of home health care services.

feeds.title: Birchwood Care Services Blog
feeds.description: As part of Birchwood Care, we have 30 years of healthcare experience. Our promise is to provide a fulfilling, independent life at home, ensuring as much independence as possible. We create bespoke home care packages to cater to the individual needs of each of our clients. Our services include assistance with washing, dressing, and preparing meals, domestic chores including shopping and laundry, complex care, and help with medication.

feeds.title: My Home Life Blog
feeds.description: Our blog features real-life stories from living, dying, working, and visiting care homes across the UK. My Home Life England promotes the positive practice and improves the quality of life for those living, visiting, and working in care homes and other care settings. We deliver positive change using our evidence-based frameworks and working collaboratively to make a difference.

feeds.title: Aspire UK Care Blog
feeds.description: Aspire UK was founded in 2000 and has grown to become a leading provider of home care services. Our goal is to help people maintain their independence and continue to do the things that bring joy and fulfillment to their lives. Whether it be taking your dog for a walk, visiting your favorite museum, or staying involved with the community, if it's important to you, our team will find a way to facilitate it.

feeds.title: Care Choices Blog
feeds.description: With hundreds of Care Homes and Providers to choose from, its difficult to know where to start. So we've made our Search for Care tool as easy as possible to use. Find the right care homes, nursing homes, home care, day services, and more in your chosen location, fast. Find the latest care news, resources, care home events, and open days, along with helpful articles right here.

feeds.title: Veritas Care Blog
feeds.description: For the past 10 years, we specialize in high-quality, low-cost live-in care solutions across Europe. Our innovative approach to care with a personal touch is a beneficial alternative to care homes. We know a lot about elderly care. Find out more from us about live-in care services, care tips for older people, senior health, and about working as a carer.

feeds.title: B&M Care Homes
feeds.description: B&M Care is a private residential and specialist dementia care provider with a current portfolio of 26 care homes in and around the Home Counties. From achievements and care staff successes to advice, support, and day-in-the-life features, the B&M Care Blog is a regularly updated portal that better connects you to one of the most recognized brands within the specialist dementia care sector.

feeds.title: Helping Hands Home Care Blog
feeds.description: Since 1989, we've supported adults of all ages to maintain their independence and stay in the comfort of their own homes. Helping Hands Home Care offers visiting and live-in care across England and Wales. Read news and real-life stories about home care from Helping Hands. Find out more about how we're supporting people in your local area on our blog.

feeds.title: Sova Healthcare Blog
feeds.description: Catch up with the latest Sova Healthcare news, updates, and goings-on! Take a look at our blog page for more information. Sova Healthcare provides a wide range of home care and specialist care services tailored to the needs and requirements of each client. This includes private home care services and care within established health institutions, both of which are delivered to the highest of standards.

feeds.title: Age Space Blog
feeds.description: Age Space is an online community for the caring generation. A place to share experience and advice on elderly care for parents, relatives, and friends.

feeds.title: The Live-in Care Hub Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with the latest live-in care news and events brought to you by the UK's leading live-in care providers

feeds.title: Four Oaks Healthcare Blog
feeds.description: We are a privately owned company who are able to provide a level of personalized service which is unrivaled by many larger companies. Our goal is to provide a level of care at home that enables you or your loved one to continue with their current lifestyle as much as possible. Stay up to date with the latest live-in care and healthcare industry news, views, and opinions with the Four Oaks Healthcare blog.

feeds.title: AUM Care Group Blog
feeds.description: At AUM Care Group, we aim to support people on their pathways to independence, so they can live the lives they want to live. We equip people with the confidence, self-esteem, and life skills they need to live independently, whether that's for the first time or following a significant change in circumstances.

feeds.title: Carehome.co.uk
feeds.description: Carehome is a guide to over 17,500 care homes, nursing homes and residential homes providing care in the UK, also the leading UK review site for care homes and nursing homes.

feeds.title: Abney and Baker Blog
feeds.description: We are family-owned, local, and proud of the role we play in our community. Our mission is to make personal support as flexible and as easy to access as booking a haircut or dentist's appointment. We're there when you need us. Read updates, information, and the latest news about Dementia on Abney and Baker's Blog!
